detail.longDescription: I’ve been learning how to use WebGPU. Right now I’m learning about setVertexBuffer() and how you set bindings that your shader can use. In my exercise code, I’ve decided to use three separate GPUBuffer s for positions, normals, and UVs. My question is, is it faster to combine positions, normals, and UVs into a single interleaved GPUBuffer , therefore resulting in a single call to setVertexBuffer() instead of three? Or does it not really make a difference? Personally, I would prefer to keep them separate for flexibility, but I’m wondering if there is a measurable performance cost for that.
